claims.claim: Bellrock Analytics, a Boston data-infrastructure firm, is hiring for senior data engineer requisition ENG-114, and Priya Nandakumar is the sole finalist after on-site interviews.
claims.source: Bellrock careers page and recruiting record

claims.claim: Nandakumar told recruiter Devon Okafor on 28 July that she holds a competing offer expiring at 9:00 AM Eastern on Monday 3 August and that she needs Bellrock's countersigned offer letter in hand before then.

Bellrock recruiting policy lists three preconditions to issuing an offer: all panel feedback recorded, background and reference checks complete, and compensation approval by the requisition's approving VP recorded in the applicant-tracking system.
The final panel interview for ENG-114 took place on Wednesday 29 July, and Bellrock policy requires panelists to record written feedback within one business day of the final interview.
claims.source: Interview schedule and recruiting policy sec. 5

claims.claim: All five panelists' written feedback on Nandakumar was recorded in the applicant-tracking system by 12:00 PM on Thursday 30 July.
Nandakumar's background and reference checks were completed and recorded on 28 July.
claims.source: Screening vendor report in the recruiting file

claims.claim: Marta Kolev, VP of Engineering, is the sole compensation approver for requisition ENG-114.

Kolev is on personal leave hiking in the Adirondacks from Thursday 30 July through Sunday 2 August, staying at a lodge with no cell coverage on the trails, and is scheduled to be back in the office at 9:00 AM Monday 3 August.
claims.source: Kolev's out-of-office notice and assistant's calendar

claims.claim: Kolev's stated practice on backcountry trips is to check work email once each evening at about 9:00 PM Eastern for roughly 15 minutes over the lodge Wi-Fi, and her assistant confirms she kept that pattern on her last three trips.

Before departing on 30 July, Kolev reviewed the proposed compensation package for Nandakumar and told Okafor she is prepared to approve it as submitted when the request reaches her; recording an approval in the applicant-tracking system takes about two minutes from any device.
claims.source: Recruiter's notes and applicant-tracking system user guide

claims.claim: Okafor submitted the compensation approval request for ENG-114, containing the package Kolev reviewed, in the applicant-tracking system at 2:00 PM Thursday 30 July, and the system emails the approver a link immediately on submission.

Bellrock's HR offer desk, run by Lena Ruiz, is staffed Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern and not on weekends, is fully staffed the week of 27 July, and its documented practice is that an offer whose approvals are all recorded by 9:00 AM on a business day is compiled, countersigned, and emailed to the candidate by 5:00 PM that same day.
claims.source: HR offer desk service standard and staffing rota
